summary_1line: Krishna explains his cosmic nature, the illusion of the three qualities, forms of devotion, and how remembrance of him at death leads to union.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna declares that all the universe hangs upon him like a row of pearls strung on a single invisible thread.
A yogi at the moment of death concentrates with closed eyes, directing the life-breath between the eyebrows while softly uttering the syllable Om.
Krishna describes himself as the taste in water, the light of the sun and moon, and the fragrance rising from the earth.
